data.bufftypecfg.1.buffdes.en: Increase attack speed by n%. Formula: speed = base speed * (1 + speed buffPara1 + speed buffPara2 + ...)

data.bufftypecfg.7.buffdes.zh: 增加最大生命值以及当前生命值，计算：生命值=初始生命+生命增长-生命减少

data.unitguide.90003.lore.zh: 来自古老森林潮湿角落的奇异花朵，深受古怪植物学家的喜爱。

data.unitguide.90004.description.en: A fast-moving melee attacker that closes the distance before striking.
data.unitguide.90004.description.zh: 移动迅速的近战进攻者，接近目标后发动攻击。

data.unitguide.90004.lore.zh: 平原上熟悉的身影，沿着比边境村落更古老的兽径漫游。

data.unitguide.90005.description.en: Launches a heavy ranged projectile at one target, with a long pause between attacks.
data.unitguide.90005.description.zh: 向单个目标发射重型远程投射物，两次攻击之间的间隔较长。
data.unitguide.90005.description.context: Attack and ability description; numeric stats stay dynamic

data.unitguide.90005.lore.en: A riverbank creature whose rugged appearance suits the old marsh tales of the rolling plains.
data.unitguide.90005.lore.zh: 粗犷的模样，与起伏平原上那些古老的沼泽传说十分相衬。
